finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an HTTP Request ('HTTP Response Splitting')
finding.trigger: If 'path' contains '\r\n' or '\n', it could inject additional headers or manipulate the HTTP request.
finding.assumptions: The 'path' parameter is derived from user input or an external source.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If 'url', 'port', or 'wordlist_path' contains malicious input, it could lead to command injection.
finding.assumptions: The 'url', 'port', and 'wordlist_path' parameters are derived from user input or an external source.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If 'url' or 'line' contains malicious input, it could lead to command injection.
finding.assumptions: The 'url' and 'line' parameters are derived from user input or an external source.

finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: If 'port' is a large negative value, it could cause an integer overflow when converted to an integer.
finding.assumptions: The 'port' parameter is derived from user input or an external source.
